## berth pkg

system packages in an org's image (applied at its next restart)

### Synopsis

The Debian packages an org's projects need and berth's image doesn't have (a browser's libraries, say).
berth builds an image for that org on top of its own, with them installed, and runs the org on it:
they survive every recreate, and the org's firewall needs no Debian mirror. add and rm build the
image at once (--no-build: at the org's next start). The running container isn't touched: the new
image applies at the org's next restart.

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_pkg/

```
berth pkg [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth pkg add acme libpq-dev
  berth pkg ls acme
```
